technique_name: Discuss the consequences of introducing AI into the workforce.
description: The introduction of AI into the workforce can have both positive and negative consequences. On the positive side, AI can automate tedious tasks, leading to increased efficiency and productivity. Additionally, AI-powered tools such as machine learning and predictive analytics can help make better decisions and assess risks more accurately.
